name: Sachi MD
description: Sachi MD v1.3.0 — modular WhatsApp bot with anti-ban, button menu, multi-pair and V2Ray proxy support.

BOT_NAME.description: Name shown in the menu and pair site.

WA_PHONE_NUMBER.description: The WhatsApp number the bot runs on, international format, digits only (e.g. 94771234567).

WA_ASK_PHONE.description: Ask for the number in a terminal. Keep 'never' on a host.

STATUS_TOKEN.description: Protects the status endpoint. Generate a long random string.

V2RAY_SUB_URL.description: Optional: v2ray/xray subscription URL or a single vmess:// | vless:// | trojan:// link. Leave empty to go direct.
